alex_ae: Starting Sapphire POC perf thread. Customer wants acceptance: 600 qps sustained, p95 < 140ms, and explanation of KMS impacts. Need short runbook + cost delta.
nina_eng: Recommend rdx-3b-quant with dedicated pool. Payloads ~250 tokens in, ~100 out. Plan: 10m warmup, 30m steady, 5m spike to 900 qps.
rick_sre: I'll size cluster: 11 nodes to start. Warmup script ready.
zoe_sec: KMS note: unwrap-per-request adds latency. We'll show cached vs strict-unwrap runs and provide logging/audit guidance.
perf-bot: perf-job-sapphire-4319990000 started on ded-cluster-3.
nina_eng: Load command (example): vegeta attack -rate=600 -duration=30m -targets=targets.txt | vegeta report -type='hist[0,50,100,150,300,500,1000]'
perf-bot: warm cache run complete. baseline p95=110ms, cached-envelope p95=135ms, unwrap-every-request p95=170ms. Throughput stable at 600 qps.
alex_ae: Good — can someone convert that to cost impact? Customer asked $/1M tokens and hourly POC estimate.
rick_sre: Node cost example $2.80/hr -> 11 nodes ~= $30.80/hr. Cached-envelope adds ~+14% compute -> approx +$0.12 per 1M tokens. Strict unwrap ~+35% -> approx +$0.32 per 1M tokens. I'll draft numbers.
zoe_sec: Security snippet: "Customer CMKs in their KMS. Redwood uses envelope encryption; nodes cache envelope keys for perf. All unwrap events logged and forwarded to customer's audit endpoint. Support for cloud HSM/FIPS available"
perf-bot: perf-job-sapphire-4319990000 finished. artifacts: s3://perf-artifacts/sapphire/4319990000/results.tar.gz
alex_ae: Thanks all — I'll send AE pack with run-summary, cost addendum, and the security blurb. Ping here if customer asks for HSM attestation docs. :thumbsup:
